subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should this issue close once WebChat gets a visible restart-recovery notice, or should the final fix also preserve or resume the interrupted in-flight turn?
rationale: The issue accepts a visible notice as one helpful direction, but its title and evidence also describe lost user input and an empty failed session, while the current candidate PR only addresses the no-notice branch.

options.title: Land scoped notice fix
options.body: Treat a visible WebChat restart-recovery transcript notice as sufficient for this issue and track broader resume/prevent behavior separately.

options.title: Require turn preservation here
options.body: Keep this issue open until restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or another recovery path prevents the interrupted turn from being lost.

options.title: Replace the conflicting candidate
options.body: Ask for a fresh narrow PR on current main that preserves the transcript-notice behavior if the existing candidate remains hard to merge.

recommendation.title: Land scoped notice fix
recommendation.body: Treat a visible WebChat restart-recovery transcript notice as sufficient for this issue and track broader resume/prevent behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses restart deferral and delivery-mirror behavior where history points to steipete as an adjacent product/code owner.
